description: This file defines the Role class within the Goteo application, managing user roles and permissions, including adding roles, permissions, loading from arrays, and database persistence.

classes.name: Goteo\Application\Role
classes.description: A class that manages roles and permissions within the Goteo application, allowing adding, checking, and persisting roles and permissions.

methods.name: addRole
methods.description: Adds a new role with a specified set of permissions and level.

methods.name: addRolePerms
methods.description: Adds permissions to an existing role.

methods.name: addRolesFromArray
methods.description: Bulk loads roles and permissions from an array, typically structured similarly to a YAML configuration.

methods.name: addPerm
methods.description: Adds a permission with associated model and relational data.

methods.name: addPermsFromArray
methods.description: Bulk loads permissions from an array.

methods.name: getRolePerms
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a specific role.

methods.name: getRoleLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of a specific role.

methods.name: roleHasPerm
methods.description: Checks if a role has a specific permission.
